paragraphs: I'm applying for the Data & Analytics Spring Intern role at the National Basketball Players Association in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before the MBA I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. A spring internship fits well with my last semester, and I'd like to put my analytics work toward an organization whose job is to look out for its members.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I built cross-platform analytics frameworks to track campaign KPIs, which helped deliver a 135% increase in engagements while cutting media spend by up to 83%. At Lenovo I turned stakeholder needs into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20%, and I owned the mapping and QA for AI-powered dashboards that saved the team 4+ hours a week on reporting.

I'm comfortable taking a loose question, pulling the data together in Excel, SQL or Tableau, checking it, and turning it into something a busy team can use. I'd be glad to talk about how I could help this spring.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the NBPA Data & Analytics Spring Intern role. At Lenovo I turned stakeholder needs into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20%, and at JPMorgan Asset Management I built KPI tracking for campaigns across platforms. I'd love to hear what the analytics team works on. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
